integrity: The proof is exact and noncomputational. The source semiconjugacy identities and bounded-displacement estimates were checked in the full arXiv text. Properness and surjectivity are proved directly from bounded displacement by finite-dimensional compactness and Brouwer degree, and the entropy equality follows from the compact factor inequality in both directions.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is restricted to finite-dimensional real phase space and to compact-subsystem entropy. Surjectivity does not give injectivity, so the structural-stability problem remains open; no equality is claimed for Bowen, co-compact, or other noncompact entropy notions.
title: Finite-dimensional generalized-hyperbolic perturbations are mutual factors
